lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice responding to a counterargument while keeping the discussion constructive.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Discussing whether remote routines or in-person routines work better for a course or shared project.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Acknowledging a counterargument, adding a concession, and restating a position.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss whether a weekly study meeting should be online or in person.

main_focus.name: concession with trots att
main_focus.description: Use trots att to admit a valid point while maintaining a different conclusion.
model_examples: Trots att det är enklare online lär jag mig mer när vi träffas.
Jag förstår argumentet, men slutsatsen blir inte självklar.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use concession language naturally 2-3 times, with additional counterargument phrases.

useful_chunks: Det beror på vad målet är.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use routine and debate vocabulary in practical, polite turns.

dialogue_shape.opening: Two possible routines are introduced with an initial preference.
dialogue_shape.middle: They raise a counterargument, concede part of it, and restate what matters most.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on a routine or a trial period.

target_complexity.repetition: concession should appear enough to practice without making the dialogue formal

focus: the conclusion or trial plan agreed

sentence_focus: one sentence restating a position with däremot
one sentence explaining what the conclusion depends on
one sentence proposing a trial period
